physicalNotes: Radius 1.13 Jupiter radii from Stassun et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..136S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 80,786 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
